call_points.text: No FY27 revenue or margin guidance; management said it cannot comment on future margins.
Structural margins improved upwards of 300 bps in FY26, driven by premium innovation and cost savings.
Crude and resins are up about 50% each, with availability significantly challenged due to the West Asia conflict.
Productivity savings of ₹38 Cr were delivered in FY26 via targeted programs.
Female grooming (Venus) contributes double digit to Grooming and is growing upwards of 20%.
Oral-B Power Oral Care grew at almost 1.5 times this year; manual oral care grows high single-digits.
Bhiwadi plant concerns were fully resolved in a few days with zero supply-related challenges.
Export revenue was hit by affiliate calls, including the Bangladesh distribution agreement closure; excluding it, growth doubles.

timeline.summary: Gillette India appointed Ashwath Rao as CFO effective July 1, 2026, following Srividya Srinivasan's transition to VP Finance.
Gillette India reported Q4FY26 revenue of ₹792 Cr (+3% YoY) and FY26 PAT of ₹654 Cr (+23% YoY), recommending a total dividend of ₹240 per share.
On 16 June 2026, Gillette India's management call reported FY26 sales of ₹3,100 Cr (up 8%) and PAT of about ₹650 Cr (up 23%), with structural margins up over 300 bps.
Q1FY27 results (standalone): revenue ₹783.02 Cr (+10.8% YoY), net profit ₹159.45 Cr (+9.4% YoY).
Gillette India held its 42nd AGM on August 31, 2026, putting 6 resolutions to vote including dividend declaration and director appointments.

Gillette India Limited’s 42nd AGM on August 31, 2026, passed all resolutions unanimously, including audited financials, dividend declaration, and Mr. Pramod Agarwal’s re-appointment as Non-Executive Director.
